# temporal precision

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:temporalPrecision`](gmeow-temporalPrecision.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/temporalPrecision>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/events`](../../slices/events.md)

The granularity to which an event's time is known — a [`gmeow:TemporalPrecision`](../classes/gmeow-TemporalPrecision.md) value (day / month / year / decade / circa). Makes the determinacy of a date explicit instead of pretending every date is to-the-day.
